en.description:
Your world has become a fantasy RPG.

Every road leads somewhere. Every walk uncovers adventure. Every landmark could hide a dungeon, a powerful boss, or legendary treasure.

Orna transforms the real world into a living fantasy RPG where exploration, turn-based combat, and deep character progression come together in one unforgettable adventure. Whether you're exploring your neighborhood or travelling somewhere new, every journey becomes part of your story.

Discover monsters, complete quests, conquer dungeons, collect legendary loot, and become the hero your world needs.

EXPLORE THE WORLD AROUND YOU
Using GPS technology, Orna transforms your surroundings into an ever-expanding fantasy world filled with monsters, dungeons, NPCs, quests, bosses, and hidden discoveries. Every place you visit has the potential to become part of your adventure.

No two journeys are ever the same.

STRATEGIC TURN-BASED RPG COMBAT
Every battle rewards planning and strategy.

Fight hundreds of unique monsters, conquer dangerous dungeons, challenge powerful world bosses, and master deep turn-based combat using weapons, spells, equipment, and abilities that evolve alongside your hero.

Whether you prefer careful tactics or overwhelming power, victory is earned through the choices you make.

BUILD YOUR HERO
Create a hero that's entirely your own.

Choose from more than 50 unique classes, each with its own specializations, skills, and playstyles. Become a mighty warrior, elusive thief, powerful mage, or experiment with countless class combinations to discover the build that suits you best.

Every new class unlocks new possibilities.

CONQUER DUNGEONS & EPIC RAIDS
Adventure into dangerous dungeons filled with monsters, puzzles, rare loot, and legendary bosses.

Take on enormous raid bosses alongside Travelers from around the world, earning powerful rewards and discovering new challenges with every monthly update.

JOIN A KINGDOM
Adventure is always better together.

Join a Kingdom to battle alongside players from across the globe in cooperative raids, Kingdom Wars, seasonal events, and community challenges. Whether you're a casual adventurer or a competitive player, you'll always have allies waiting.

BUILD YOUR ORIGIN TOWN
Create a home that's uniquely yours. Construct buildings, upgrade shops, improve your forge, and develop your Origin Town into the heart of your adventure. As your town grows, so do the opportunities available to every future journey.

JOIN THE TRAVELER'S GUILD
Your steps have never been more rewarding. Walking helps you discover new locations, encounter powerful enemies, uncover hidden rewards, and complete Traveler's Guild challenges as you explore the world around you.

Whether you're walking around the block or hiking your favourite trail, every step moves your adventure forward.

BEAUTIFUL RETRO PIXEL ART
Inspired by the golden era of classic RPGs, Orna combines handcrafted pixel art with modern online gameplay to create a timeless fantasy world filled with charm, nostalgia, and endless discovery.

Why Players Love Orna

• Explore a fantasy RPG built around the real world

• Discover dungeons, monsters, quests, and hidden treasures

• Battle challenging bosses using strategic turn-based combat

• Unlock more than 50 unique character classes

• Collect powerful weapons, equipment, and legendary loot

• Build and expand your own Origin Town

• Join Kingdoms for cooperative raids and competitive PvP

• Complete Traveler's Guild challenges while exploring outdoors

• Experience fresh monthly events, quests, and content updates

Official Subreddit: https://www.reddit.com/r/OrnaRPG/ Official Discord: http://discord.gg/orna Release notes: https://playorna.com/releases/ World data © OpenStreetMap (http://www.openstreetmap.org/copyright)

With frequent content updates, seasonal events, community challenges, and one of mobile gaming's most passionate player communities, there's always another reason to go outside and continue your journey.

ja.description:
RPG adventures await in Orna, a classic MMO fantasy game loaded with duels, monsters, raids, and dungeon bosses. Transform the world around you into your very own classic turn based RPG game with an MMO & GPS twist!


Years ago, a great deity, Mammon, started a world-changing event called The Falling, changing the lands forever and covering them in darkness. Embark on a grand RPG adventure, discovering an open world, shrouded in mystery and seek peace amongst chaos. 


Create your origin town, enjoy turn-based battles, collect and upgrade your gear, weapons and armor to power up. Immerse yourself in the real world around you with a MMORPG game that allows you to experience your own neighborhood in a real life role playing game.

GPS technology will turn the world around you into an open-world MMORPG. Go outside and claim real world landmarks as your own! This online MMO & fantasy RPG game is full of surprises and battles to take part in. Get ready to build your own fantasy kingdom.


We’re excited to meet you, Traveler! Join the open fantasy MMO & RPG adventure today.


ORNA's FEATURES:

MMO / RPG CLASS SYSTEM – Unlock over 50 unique classes with even more specializations. Start as a thief, mage or warrior to choose your own role playing game path!

BATTLE PVE STYLE - Battle dungeon bosses and other monsters and follow the fantasy story of the Unfelled as you seek peace in a land fallen to chaos!
FIGHTING GAME WITH A PVP ARENA - face off against other fantasy RPG players in a multiplayer arena
MMORPG WORLD RAIDS - portals to other realms will open up allowing you to team up and join Travelers from across the world to face off and battle against epic bosses together 
BASE BUILDING - build your Origin Town, upgrade & level up buildings and lead your villagers to prosperity and rewards
RPG KINGDOM GAMEPLAY - join a guild with other RPG players of your faction to take on raids, dungeons, bosses and unique events together
DUNGEON CRAWLER – find loot and other treasures to level up your character and battle the dungeon bosses
RPG CHARACTER EXPRESSION – create your own role playing character using any combination of armor, weapons and spells
GPS MEMORY HUNTS – embark on a real world GPS RPG adventure through your own environment to yield powerful loot
8BIT PIXEL ART STYLE - featuring artwork that will remind you of a classic, old-school RPG or MMORPG


FIGHT IN YOUR OWN RPG ADVENTURE
• A  new MMORPG that allows you to team up with friends or tackle things alone.
• Fight in the arena or experience a Dungeon Boss in an epic dungeon crawl.
• Become an RPG maker and allow your choices to level up your character, unlocking new gear and classes!
• Experience diverse and complex role playing character classes and customize them to play this turn based RPG your way!
• How will your RPG adventure play out? The choice is yours.


BUILD A FANTASY RPG and MMO KINGDOM TOGETHER
• Join a Kingdom online to conquer the world with your guildmates!
• Battle in PvP content in the form of Kingdom Wars or tackle PvE challenging raids together.
• Meet new friends in this MMORPG and expand your kingdom to climb the leaderboards!


With monthly updates including original questline events and more fantasy game and RPG features, join us and experience a new kind of role playing game. Brush up on your old school RPG skills and see the RPG online world that Orna has to offer.


Our free MMO & RPG game has an amazing online RPG community:

Official Discord: http://discord.gg/orna
Release notes: https://playorna.com/releases/
Official Patreon: https://www.patreon.com/northernforge

de.description:
Geocaching plus klassisches rundenbasiertes Rollenspiel.

Erlebe in diesem einzigartigen GPS-gesteuerten Multiplayer-Rollenspiel rundenbasierte Kämpfe. Sammle und verbessere deine Waffen und Rüstungen, nimm an PvP-Schlachten teil, kämpfe dich durch Dungeons, töte Drachen und erobere mit deinem Mobilgerät online Sehenswürdigkeiten der realen Welt, wo immer du dich befindest.

Spieler von Orna:

-------------------------------

* Erkunde Dungeons in einer Fantasy-Welt, indem du deine eigene Welt erforschst.
* 8-Bit-Pixelgrafiken mit einem modernen Touch.
* Schließe dich Königreichen an, um in Kriegen und Online-Raids zu kämpfen.
* Fordere andere Spieler in einer PvP-Arena heraus.
* Steige Level auf und erreiche mit deinem Fortschritt mehr als 50 Charakterklassen.
 * Sammle über 1.000 Gegenstände im Spiel.
* Lass deinen Charakter gegen über 300 Monstertypen antreten.
* Finde und besiege über 100 einzigartige Bosse und Überfälle.

-------------------------------
